strict_cfg_after.scope: Strict entry-reachable CFG comparison with exact unique COFF symbol identities and unchanged engine addresses and complete read-only C-string/DIALOG-token contents. Matched callees and globals remain identity/behavior assumptions; padding and direct jump trampolines are ignored. No whole-game or arbitrary callee equivalence claim.

manual_source_reviews.card_temple_altisaur: Short-circuit guards keep the damage-card ID check before signed attachment checks and the subtype callback. The same cached damage pointer supplies live info_slot reads after that callback; affected globals are read again for prevent_damage.
manual_source_reviews.remove_eot_unless_cb: Retain the first getter/player-sign guard and a second getter before trigger/global checks. Positive turns_left decrements on every eligible event. On resolution, capture attachment coordinates before check_state, query blessing only if that state test is false, and retain the attached-only exile early return versus legacy exile.
manual_source_reviews.card_coffin_puppets: Land-sacrifice test initialization remains unconditional. The graveyard query and ability-cost query remain short-circuited in that order, with the same flags, six zero mana costs, trailing parameters, return-8 encoding and exact spell_fizzled!=1 result.
manual_source_reviews.card_lathiel_the_bounteous_dawn: Keep both conditional eot_trigger calls and default target initialization even for zero life gained. Negative nonzero life gained can still reach the getter and target-count clear without a loop iteration. The positive loop increments before formatting and stops without an overflowing increment after INT_MAX; chosen target fields are read after each picker callback.
manual_source_reviews.card_insubordination: Keep in_play, fresh aura getter, attachment getter and the end-step query before testing the AI event shortcut. Retain the cached attachment player, native state mask 0x44 and final aura controller helper for every path.
manual_source_reviews.card_timestream_navigator: The same four events perform one blessing query; other events return after ascend. Activation captures library before count_deck and IID lookup, writes the IID before obliteration, and then invokes GAA. Resolution captures parent_card from the first getter and parent_controller from the second getter before time_walk. The common GAA call retains 2UU and untapped flags.
manual_source_reviews.card_circle_of_protection_shadow: Combine the duplicated target-definition initialization while retaining the original arithmetic event-range predicate. Every accepted path still calls the instance getter once; only resolution validates the target and fetches the damage instance. The three ORed GAA flags equal 0x1000006, the prompt and 1-generic cost are unchanged.
manual_source_reviews.card_glorious_enforcer: The lifelink and combat helpers retain their order. Both life values remain reads after the combat helper, with the same signed comparison and double-strike keyword; removing a duplicated zero return changes no action.
manual_source_reviews.card_robber_of_the_rich: Capture the opponent for the hand comparison/deck read and exile call, but retain the new 1-current_turn evaluation and csvid load after rfg_top_card_of_deck. The saved IID is not replaced by a post-exile deck read. Land exclusion and effect flags are unchanged.
manual_source_reviews.card_tajuru_paragon: Kicker still precedes kicked and etb_ability on every event. On ETB, initialize/get all reported subtypes before creating the test and retain the original five subtype stores and F2_MULTISUBTYPE=3. The compiled TYPE_ANY argument is checked as 0xff, with identical reveal destinations and flags.
manual_source_reviews.card_floodhound: Retain the original arithmetic grouping of ai_modifier + hand_count * -10 + 70 and its placement before investigate. Only the hexadecimal spelling and unused result temporary are removed; the common GAA cost/flags are unchanged.

compiled_verification.scope: Nine complete entry-reachable native/current CFG correspondences under the same strict checker that rejected all twenty prior bodies. Exact unique COFF/engine identities and full read-only C-string/DIALOG-token contents are assumptions; no predicate or return-tail relaxations are enabled. Eleven other bodies have manual control-flow/source reviews, with selected actual compiled callback sites recorded. Call-site counts confirm emitted sites only, not dynamic path equivalence. Twenty source replacements reconstruct exactly the thirteen raw/canonical files; no untouched source bytes are rewritten. No gameplay fixture or full comparison refresh was rerun.
